details.shipping: Shipping across the US and Canada

payment.title: Pay online · Stripe
payment.desc: For orders in the US and Canada, payment is taken online at checkout — through the secure Stripe payment gateway. As soon as the payment succeeds, we prepare your parcel for dispatch.

items.name: Tracked shipping
items.note: Tracked delivery to any address in the US, including Alaska and Hawaii, and in Canada. The rate and the transit time come from the carrier once you enter the address.

items.name: Made-to-order merch
items.note: Merch is printed and shipped by our print partner, so it travels in its own parcel on its own schedule.

items.name: Digital editions
items.note: E-books are emailed right after payment — nothing is shipped.

items.title: Choose books
items.desc: Add titles to your cart and proceed to checkout.

items.title: Enter shipping address
items.desc: We ship to all 50 states, including Alaska & Hawaii, and across Canada — the rate is quoted for your exact address.

items.title: Pay online
items.desc: Secure card payment via Stripe — no account required.

items.title: Get a tracking number
items.desc: Books leave within 1–2 business days, and every parcel travels with tracking.

finalCta.titleSuffix: and heading to you in North America.
